locations.name: The Battery
locations.factShort: The Battery, formerly known as Battery Park, is a 25-acre public park located at the southern tip of Manhattan Island in New York City facing New York Harbor.

locations.name: Valentino Pier
locations.factShort: Red Hook is a neighborhood in western Brooklyn, New York City, United States, within the area once known as South Brooklyn.

locations.name: The Queens County Farm Museum
locations.factShort: The Queens County Farm Museum, also known as Queens Farm, is a 47-acre farm in the Glen Oaks neighborhood of Queens in New York City. The farm occupies the city's largest remaining tract of undisturbed farmland (in operation since 1697), and is still a working farm today.

locations.name: The Kingsbridge Armory
locations.factShort: The Kingsbridge Armory, also known as the Eighth Regiment Armory, is a decommissioned armory at Jerome Avenue and West Kingsbridge Road in the Kingsbridge Heights neighborhood of the Bronx in New York City.

locations.name: The Eldridge Street Synagogue
locations.factShort: The Eldridge Street Synagogue is an Orthodox Jewish synagogue at 12–16 Eldridge Street in the Chinatown and Lower East Side neighborhoods of Manhattan in New York City. Built in 1887 for Congregation Kahal Adath Jeshurun, the synagogue is one of the first erected in the U.S. by Eastern European Jews.
